says: In next/, the mail wake's clear in catchUp requires stop === letters.length (decision 0528: a step has read every letter), but no law fails when that check is removed.
proof: In a scratch worktree at 2e22aa4a3, changing `if (stop === letters.length && nothingLeftBehind(cmds))` to `if (nothingLeftBehind(cmds))` and running `volta run --node 26.13.0 pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 next/packages/libfabrika/src/node/ProgramMailRuntime.test.ts` printed `Tests 18 passed (18)`.
cost: The full-read part of 0528 can break or be deleted with no red law; if it is unreachable because a pending exit is always an owed host Cmd, the guard is dead weight nobody can tell apart from a needed check.
